theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable index types carry sets A,B,C with integer maps $a,b,c$. Fix modulus/shift $p,\delta$, parameters $h,J,k$ with $k<J$, wanted label $w$ satisfying its A membership and lifted-key congruence, and a list $U$ of valid depth-$k$ prefixes. Suppose memory stores the exact original source transforms, sorted next-level prefix index, box-pointer row and every corresponding local signed-box transform, together with both current parent-mask rows. All retained data end before the left output, whose reservation of $|U|G(h)$ cells ends before the right output; the latter ends before child scratch. Reserve thereafter complete child masks, left/right child rows, count/selection rows, query-mask buffer and polynomial scratch, in the stated order. Assume exact capacity, power/remainder workspace and word-magnitude bounds, next-level switch/cut conditions, addresses fitting words and depth $d+2W+17$ allowed, where $W=J\cdot464h$.

The fixed step returns the length of

$$U'=\operatorname{flatMap}_{u\in U}\operatorname{positiveChildren}(I,w,u),$$

where $I$ is the original raw-incidence set, and writes precisely the aligned left/right masks of $U'$ in that order. It meets its stated $(h,J,k,t,|U|)$ time and preserves all cells below child scratch outside the two actual output intervals.

This is the full executed frontier transition used by the exact original-incidence reporting tree.
